description: Query vulnerabilities for multiple packages in one call — the primary tool for dependency audits, SBOM scanning, and lockfile triage. Pass up to 1000 mixed {name, ecosystem, version} tuples and {purl, version?} identifiers, with exactly one embedded or separate version per PURL. Each entry in the response corresponds positionally to the input. Each finding includes CVE aliases for chaining to nist-nvd-mcp-server for CVSS scoring. Large replies retain the complete summary. For overflow, repeat the original packages array with page: overflow.page. Continue the same path with offset: page.nextOffset and revision: page.revision until nextOffset is null. Retrieve each entries[].deferred.path separately at offset zero without a revision. Do not pass the output page object as input. /results/17 selects original input row 17, even when earlier rows failed. Pages are fresh lookups and do not recompute the initial summary; restart a changed node without a revision. Transmission overflow and upstream truncated are separate; neither confirms clean.

packages.description: Packages to audit. One entry per dependency. Positional: result[i] corresponds to packages[i].

name.description: Exact package name in its ecosystem.

purl.description: Use purl instead of the tuple, never together with name or ecosystem.

version.description: Exact package version, never a range.

anyOf.description: PURL alternative with exactly one version source.

purl.description: Complete Package URL, such as pkg:pypi/jinja2@3.1.4. Supply its version either here or separately, exactly once.

version.description: Exact version only when the PURL does not embed one.

page.description: Repeat the original packages array with page: overflow.page first. Continue using path, offset: page.nextOffset and revision: page.revision. /results/17/... keeps original row index 17; start deferred children without a revision.

offset.description: Start at zero; on later calls set this to the previous page.nextOffset until it is null. Text offsets count Unicode code points.

path.description: Field pointer announced by overflow or entries[].deferred.path; empty string selects the root. Keep the same path while following nextOffset.

revision.description: Use page.revision only when continuing the same path. Omit on the first call to any deferred child path; restart without it after stale_page_revision.

name: osv_query_batch

effectiveQuery.description: Compact scan summary (package and outcome counts), echoed on edge-case batches for content-only clients.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_page_path`: The pointer is unknown or cannot fit a bounded page. `stale_page_revision`: The re-fetched node or input order changed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Present on all-clean or all-errors batches — the aggregate outcome for content-only clients.

overflow.description: Transmission overflow disclosure; independent of upstream truncation.

complete.description: Complete top-level fields retained in this response.

notice.description: Transmission omission and fresh re-fetch semantics.

omitted.description: Omitted values, all addressable through page.path.

items.description: An oversized child; parent offset advances past this descriptor.

path.description: Exact child pointer to retrieve separately.

total.description: Number of child entries or Unicode code points; one for scalars.

page.description: Repeat the original tool input with page: overflow.page. Later select path, offset: page.nextOffset and revision: page.revision; do not pass the output page object.

offset.description: Start at zero; on later calls set this to the previous page.nextOffset until it is null. Text offsets count Unicode code points.

path.description: Field pointer announced by overflow or entries[].deferred.path; empty string selects the root. Keep the same path while following nextOffset.

revision.description: Use page.revision only when continuing the same path. Omit on the first call to any deferred child path; restart without it after stale_page_revision.

page.description: One bounded page of an addressed normalized node.

entries.description: Source-order entries for arrays, objects and scalars.

items.description: One source entry, complete or deferred.

deferred.description: Retrievable child descriptor when its value does not fit.

path.description: Exact child pointer to retrieve separately.

total.description: Number of child entries or Unicode code points; one for scalars.

key.description: Object key or original array index.

nextOffset.description: Next offset, strictly greater or null when finished.

notice.description: Fresh re-fetch disclosure; no saved historical snapshot.

revision.description: SHA-256 revision of the addressed normalized node; batch collection uses original input order.

text.description: Verbatim Unicode code-point slice for strings.

total.description: Total entries or Unicode code points.

preview.description: Compact view; overflow identifies omissions. This is not the complete record.

results.description: Per-package results, positionally matching the input array.

error.description: Per-package error message (e.g. invalid ecosystem). Null on success.

purl.description: Original PURL when supplied; name, ecosystem and version show its effective coordinate on success.

truncated.description: True when OSV paginated beyond the fetch cap for this package — its result may be INCOMPLETE. A truncated row with no vulnerabilities is NOT confirmed clean.

vulnCount.description: Number of vulnerabilities found. 0 when not vulnerable or on error.

vulnerable.description: True if any vulnerabilities were found.

vulns.description: Vulnerabilities found. Empty array when clean.

items.description: One vulnerability found for this package.

aliases.description: CVE IDs and other aliases. Accepted by nist-nvd-mcp-server for CVSS scores and CISA KEV status.

items.description: A CVE ID or other alias.

fixedVersions.description: Every fixed version the advisory lists for this row's package, in record order — one per affected interval, typically one per release line. Excludes other packages' fixes and GIT commits. Empty when the advisory lists no fix for this package.

items.description: A version that fixes the vulnerability for this package.

severityLabel.description: Severity label: "LOW", "MODERATE", "HIGH", "CRITICAL", or null. Same derivation as osv_query_package: database_specific.severity, then an Ubuntu priority, then the highest CVSS v3/v4 score, using this row's package-level severity entries when the record has none.

summary.description: Aggregate statistics across the full batch.

cleanCount.description: Packages confirmed clean — no vulnerabilities, no error, and not truncated.

errorCount.description: Packages that returned an error (e.g. invalid ecosystem).

totalVulns.description: Total vulnerability instances across all packages (may double-count shared advisories).

truncatedCount.description: Packages whose OSV results were truncated (may be incomplete). A truncated package with no findings is NOT counted as clean.

vulnerableCount.description: Packages with at least one vulnerability.

worstSeverity.description: Highest severity label seen across all findings, or null if no severity data available.

title: Osv Query Batch
